Package com.spyj.logger

Class StatsTracker

java.lang.Object
com.spyj.logger.StatsTracker
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventSubscriber
public class StatsTracker extends Object implements EventSubscriber
An EventSubscriber that maintains a continuously-updated set of aggregated statistics across all telemetry event categories. Counters are updated incrementally as each event arrives, ensuring an up-to-date snapshot is always available via getStats().

All public methods are synchronized to allow safe concurrent access from both the BlueJ event thread and the JavaFX Application Thread used by EditorListener.

Author:
Mykel Dedier

  • Method Details

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets all counters and clears all frequency maps and sets. After calling this method the tracker is in the same state as a freshly constructed instance.

    • onEvent

      public void onEvent(TelemetryEvent event)
      Processes a telemetry event and updates the relevant statistics. Null events or events with a null type are silently ignored.
      Specified by:
      onEvent in interface EventSubscriber
      Parameters:
      event - the telemetry event to process

    • getStats

      public Map<String,Object> getStats()
      Returns a snapshot of all aggregated statistics, grouped by category. The returned map contains the following top-level keys, each mapping to a nested stats map: Session, Project Lifecycle, Class Lifecycle, Editor Interactions, Compilation, Execution, Event Counts.
      Returns:
      a map of category names to their respective statistics maps
